proof_obligations.PO-LAYOUT: V retains all native harmonic frequencies. Binary integer q-loops, generator commutation sums and every original frequency reconstruction generate S. W=V+S is complete, capped as a whole and explicitly charged.
proof_obligations.PO-BLOCK: Supplied exact original and extension matrices must agree on every original entry. Hermiticity, unit diagonal and all actual equal-difference identities are checked, not only anchors.
proof_obligations.PO-FLAT: An independent original Hermitian base block reconstructs all extended Gram entries exactly, proving rank extension equals rank original. No eigenvalue threshold is used.
proof_obligations.PO-TRANSLATION: Reconstructed shifts preserve the exact base metric/dependencies and satisfy every addition trace, commuting generators and q-order. The anchor is refined by exact finite-order spectral projectors, retaining at mostR common branches.
proof_obligations.PO-POSITIVITY: Every extracted weight is strictly positive in the specified cyclotomic embedding and sums to1; characters reproduce the entire supplied matrix, certifying PSD without trusting a producer flag. Nonreal, negative or unresolved weights never pass.
proof_obligations.PO-DEQUANTIZATION: A support character is chosen with exact native harmonic score at least the verified mixture score. OnlyR atoms are tested. This is conditional on supplied classical moments; full log likelihood and held-out recovery are separate.
proof_obligations.PO-COST: Field degree2q/3, enlarged dense matrix entries and O(n*q^2*R) projector terms are charged. Exact rational coefficient heights/bit arithmetic and completion/tomography costs remain necessary. This is not polynomial in log q for exponentially large q.
proof_obligations.PO-NONEXTENSION: Retained native unit-basis pair moments1 and zero anchors are rejected before constructing W or hitting its cap. Nonflat matrices alone are not declared nonrepresentable.
proof_obligations.PO-MISSING: No native-noise completion solver, approximate flatness theorem or quantum receiver is supplied. Known-atom producers are calibration only. Independent mathematical review and novelty checks remain required.

falsifiable_experiments: A positive native-label character mixture is not recovered exactly from its supplied matrices.
A signed/indefinite mixture or unresolved weight sign is accepted as PSD.
An original block is changed, a q-loop/commutation translate is dropped, or only a partial matrix is certified.
The retained native nonextension witnesses pass or are hidden by an enlarged-matrix resource cap.
Native noisy source structure fails to yield a costed exact or robust approximate flat completion.
